ryr1_diagnostic.interpretation: The corrected recommendation matches no reference-action branch. Every nonempty RYR1 recommendation reaches the generic 0.5 fallback, including the corrected reference scored against itself. The resulting 96.76% is a software diagnostic, not clinically meaningful corrected-reference concordance. Zero-credit arithmetic sensitivity remains 96.31%.
